blueprintSignals.definition: per-chunk tag: user, retrieved document, email, web page or tool output

blueprintSignals.name: Outbound-call policy violations
blueprintSignals.definition: tool calls whose arguments or destinations fall outside the allow-list for the user intent
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Allow-lists must derive from the user request, never from model output

label: For "LLM Prompt-Injection & Jailbreak Detection": Detect direct and indirect prompt injection and jailbreaks in LLM application inputs and retrieved content before they reach the model or tools. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Static public jailbreak datasets.
